by
  have h2 : p * (1 - p) = p - p * p := by simp [mul_sub]
  have h3 : p - p * p ≤ 1 / 4 :=
    by
      rw [h2]
      have h4 : p ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ p ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
      obtain h5 | h6 := h4
      · have h7 : p - p * p ≤ 1 / 4 :=
          by
            have h8 : p ≤ 1 / 2 := h5
            have h9 : 1 - p ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
            have h10 : p * (1 - p) ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) :=
              by
                apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                exact h8
                exact h9
                exact le_rfl
            rw [one_div] at h10
            exact h10
        · have h7 : p - p * p ≤ 1 / 4 :=
            by
              have h8 : p ≥ 1 / 2 := h6
              have h9 : 1 - p ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
              have h10 : p * (1 - p) ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) :=
                by
                  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  exact h8
                  exact h9
                  exact le_rfl
              rw [one_div] at h10
              exact h10
      exact h7
  exact h3
